verdicts.strongest_argument: This restates published guidance and the market has already paid for it once, violently. The EPS of $0.07 down 84.1%, the $462.4m revenue up 2.19% and the price/cost recovery commitment - including its explicit conditionality on 'normal seasonality and subsiding inflation' - are all the company's own words from the 2026-06-04 release, and they are in the stored body at docs/a220e3377c889df309423af49d6f99e2300d27de.txt at the 2026-06-05 entries. The baseline records the market's response as -13.42%, the largest reaction in the seven-event set: the conditionality was read and discounted on the day. The finding's residual is that 'nobody in the observed corpus has checked the conditions', which is an n_queries=0 statement about a capture whose entire non-filing corpus is one Stocktwits thread - it is a fact about the sweep, not about whether building-products analysts have been tracking resin, aluminium and vinyl costs and US window shipments, which they do continuously. Worse for the finding, its own independence citation publishes the very framing it claims is missing: a same-day analytic item stating 'downside fades if inflation subsides, second-half price/cost recovery lands, and normal seasonality returns'. That is the conditional structure, itemised, in the capture. What is genuinely left is that this print is the first observation of a two-quarter promise - which is the calendar, known to everyone, and equally capable of resolving up.

verdicts.baseline_evidence: Baseline history records 2026-06-04 amc at -13.42%, the largest of seven reactions, on the release containing this guidance - the conditionality was priced on the day it was issued. Tape into the print: spot 18.76, run_up_5d -4.67%, run_up_20d -10.11%, pct_from_52w_high -16.81% but pct_from_52w_low +66.76%, realised_vol_20d 43.3%. The market has kept de-rating through the quarter; median reaction 9.55% with five of seven negative.
verdicts.what_would_change_it: A dated observation of one of the three conditions inside the quarter - a resin or aluminium price series, a US window-shipment datapoint, a competitor's price commentary - showing the recovery could not have landed.

interactions: none - single finding, but note that its cited corroboration is the document that most weakens it.
